record.evidence_quote: the experimental value σ = 10−12 mS/cm we use for 47i (Li4 P2 O7) may be lower than the actual value, as the literature only reports an upper bound (σexp < 10−7 mS/cm).
record.notes: Experimental value taken from the OBELiX database (Therrien et al., 2025) and used as the reference for this material. The authors state that the literature reports only an upper bound (<10−7 mS/cm), so 10−12 mS/cm is a proxy the authors chose, not a measured value. Temperature, method and density not stated for this value. Computed MD conductivities appear only in figures, so no records were made for them.
